CORRECTED primary and secondary. Original had all three deltoid heads as primary (Lateral, Anterior, Posterior Deltoid) and mid back (Upper Traps, Rhomboids) + Rotator Cuff as secondary — this was wrong. The movement is forearm pronation/supination, not a shoulder movement. Primary changed to: forearms (Wrist Flexors, Wrist Extensors) as forearm rotator stabilizers, and biceps (Biceps Brachii) which is a primary supinator of the forearm. Secondary changed to: shoulders (Lateral Deltoids) only — the lateral deltoids isometrically hold the arms extended to the sides throughout the movement. Upper Traps and Rhomboids removed as they are not meaningfully engaged in this light isometric hold. Rotator Cuff removed as it is not a primary stabilizer here.
